changes.result: Moved the primary ref to the tour Next/Done action. Returning to step zero focuses the enabled Next action. Added DOM and Edge native Tab/Shift+Tab regressions.

Added a monotonic sequence per GET alongside context generation. Stale polling replies cannot replace state or revision. Polls do not start during explicit opens. Save, view changes, unmount and pending proposals invalidate in-flight reads.
The Edge runner now requires both SVG sectors to keep the same path, bounds and fill for 500 ms before capturing. Product animation remains enabled.
